'''Grafendale''' is a location mentioned by [[Androl]].

Androl compares the design and layout of the [[Black Tower]]'s village to Grafendale.{{ref/book|13|46}} It is almost certainly a village or town in [[Andor]].

{{quote|Here, clusters of two-storied buildings were arranged much like any small town in Andor. Peaked roofs, thatched, with straight wooden walls, some stone and brick as well. A double line of them ran down the center of the village. Looking only at those, one might have thought he was strolling through [[New Braem]] or Grafendale.|Androl||{{ref/book|13|46}}}}
